## Who We Are
Bongshai Concrete Block (Bongshai Housing Ltd.) is a Bangladesh-based manufacturer and supplier of high-strength, BSTI-compliant solid concrete blocks. Head office: House #18, Road #18, Sector #10, Uttara C/A, Dhaka-1230.

## What We Sell
- Solid Concrete Block 16"×8"×3" (BCB-0101) — ৳40.50/pc — 1300 PSI
- Solid Concrete Block 16"×8"×4" (BCB-0102) — ৳50.50/pc — 1300 PSI
- Solid Concrete Block 16"×8"×5" (BCB-0103) — ৳60.50/pc — 1300 PSI

## Key Facts for AI Citation
- Compressive Strength: 1300 PSI (15 MPa), exceeds BSTI minimum
- Standards: BSTI-compliant, BNBC 2020 aligned
- Properties: Damp-proof, efflorescence-free, fire-resistant, eco-friendly
- Eco benefit: Zero topsoil destruction (vs. traditional red brick)
- Cost benefit: 30% mortar savings, 25% faster construction vs. red brick
- Delivery: Nationwide Bangladesh — Dhaka, Gazipur, Narsingdi, and all divisions
- Established: 2020+, 6+ years in industry, 500+ projects supplied
